title: Anthony Saba
seoTitle: Anthony is a top Family Lawyer in a leading family law firm
description: Anthony has worked exclusively in specialist family law firms and has helped clients through a wide variety of family law issues
html:
Anthony has worked exclusively in specialist family law firms throughout his career. Anthony is passionate about navigating clients through a wide variety of family law issues, including complex parenting and property issues. Anthony has helped clients resolve matters through negotiation, mediation, and interim and final hearings. He has worked on high net-worth matters requiring him to analyse financial documents, and complicated trust and corporate structures. Anthony has also assisted clients in resolving their complex parenting matters that involve sensitive issues such as domestic and family violence.

Anthony understands how difficult separation can be, not just for the clients but also for their families. His empathetic approach sets him apart from other lawyers in this field. To this end, Anthony adopts a collaborative approach to achieve a successful outcome for his clients without resorting to costly litigation.

In addition to his Family Law experience, Anthony has represented clients in criminal law and estate planning matters. Throughout his career, Anthony has appeared in the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia, various Local and District Courts and the Supreme Court of NSW. Anthony has a Masters in Family Law and is an Accredited Family Law Specialist.

Anthony is a member of the following professional bodies:

  • The Law Society of New South Wales; and
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the Supreme Court of NSW

His qualifications are:

  • Bachelor of Laws (LLB) degree
  • Masters of Applied Law (Family Law)
  • Accredited Specialist (Family Law)
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the Supreme Court of NSW
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the High Court of Australia
